An '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] he began seeing a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl named [[Tivva]]. Due to the difference in their ages, Tivva's sister [[Vette]] was highly disgusted by their relationship.<ref name="And the Old Moff" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Moff is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Vette's companion mission.<ref name="And the Old Moff" />
